misprints.note: Genitive printed without a rough breathing.
Printed this way and kept; the OCR had misread it as ποτιάτατος.
There is a stray full stop after the Swedish preposition 'i'.
Under Supvisa, 'drinking song' would be ποτικόν. The print clearly shows λ.
The relative pronoun is printed as δ, with no breathing or accent.
The comma after ἀμβλύς is missing in the print.
The λ is dropped in the print, under Svagsynthet.
The ending has an accent on the iota in the print, at the end of the strip under Suspendera.

uncertain.note: The last letter looks like ι plus a comma, not ς. It could be βρόχθος with broken type. I transcribed it as βρόχθοι.
The κ in this face looks like x. I read κ because there is no descender, so not ἔγχαφος. The same applies to ῥακῆς and κρηπίς.

uncertain.text: ἕλος, ἕλειος, ἑλειότροφος, ἑλώδης, ἕλη, ἑλῶδες
uncertain.note: I read rough breathings throughout. The breathing glyphs are small and partly fused with the accents.
The breathing has an extra tick that could be an acute (ὥς). I read it as a plain rough breathing.
